title: Evaluation of the vector dual map
statement: For every natural number $n$ and vectors $\gamma,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the linear functional associated to $\gamma$ by the standard vector-to-dual-space equivalence, evaluated at $x$, is the dot product $\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i x_i$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
